comment: Original Jammer development range. Real human input and server phases, no granted equipment or teleports. FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0, FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/test/jammer-range.json, FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/jammer-range.json. Not a completed M03.

states.name: jammer_range_supplies
states.note: Claim the Rifle, Shotgun and bullets through the normal supply path.

states.name: jammer_folded
states.note: The folded service transmitter in the first lane before its encounter wakes.

states.name: jammer_pulse_motion
states.note: Approach along the open lane, then observe the committed pulse from a closer lateral view without firing. The bright point advances only on server snapshots.

states.name: jammer_launch_audio
states.note: The isolated real launch capture has radio muted and no player shots. This records software audio output, not hardware listening acceptance.

states.name: jammer_first_defeat
states.note: Sidestep the committed pulses and defeat the first Jammer with the Rifle.

states.name: jammer_flank
states.note: The freight-car flank gives sight breaks and a health detour before the mixed fight.

states.name: jammer_mixed_fight
states.note: Defeat both named combatants in the mixed fight. The solo lane already proves a launch; here ordinary return fire can interrupt the Jammer while the Sweeper pressures the flank.

states.name: jammer_range_exit
states.note: Finish the mixed range and reach its final landmark. This fixture has no campaign departure or save transition.
